headline: Lees-McRae unbeaten and conceding almost nothing
dek: Lees-McRae have won eight matches and drawn two without defeat, and have conceded four goals all season. Francis Marion, level with Young Harris at the top of the conference table, visit them on Saturday, and neither side has lost a conference match.
displaced_by: Francis Marion's win at Ferrum left the standing dek's eighth-win figure out of date; Lees-McRae's unbeaten run on four goals conceded, with Francis Marion visiting Saturday, is the story now.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 29 goals, from twelve different scorers, are the most in the conference and have still come with two defeats; the scoring is spread widely and has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: Erskine are now the only side in the conference without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Berry's home match against Shorter.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King's win at North Greenville was their first of the season after eight defeats; they have scored six goals and conceded twenty.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andre Camargo, a freshman, has nine of Chowan's 29 goals and five assists, from 29 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won nine matches, drawn one and lost one, and have conceded seven goals in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Michael Arzillo has made 42 saves for Ferrum and conceded eleven goals, a save percentage of .792.

last_match.line: King's first win of the season; they had lost every match before it, and North Greenville had beaten Ferrum the previous Saturday.

next_match.line: Lees-McRae have not lost a match this season; Francis Marion have won every conference match they have played and lost only once in any competition.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
